import unittest

from solution import stamp_matrix


class StampMatrixTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_overlay_transparency_and_deep_copy(self):
        base = [[{"base": [1]}, {"keep": [2]}], [{"x": [3]}, {"y": [4]}]]
        patch = [[{"new": [9]}, None]]
        result = stamp_matrix(base, patch, 1, 0)

        self.assertEqual(result, [[{"base": [1]}, {"keep": [2]}], [{"new": [9]}, {"y": [4]}]])
        self.assertEqual(base, [[{"base": [1]}, {"keep": [2]}], [{"x": [3]}, {"y": [4]}]])
        self.assertEqual(patch, [[{"new": [9]}, None]])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0], base[0][0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1][0], patch[0][0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1][1], base[1][1])

        result[1][0]["new"].append(10)
        result[1][1]["y"].append(5)
        self.assertEqual(patch[0][0], {"new": [9]})
        self.assertEqual(base[1][1], {"y": [4]})
        base[0][0]["base"].append(7)
        self.assertEqual(result[0][0], {"base": [1]})

    def test_custom_transparent_value(self):
        base = [[{"retained": []}]]
        patch = [[[]]]
        result = stamp_matrix(base, patch, 0, 0, transparent=[])
        self.assertEqual(result, base)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0], base[0][0])

    def test_empty_and_zero_width_matrices(self):
        base = [[{"a": []}]]
        result = stamp_matrix(base, [], 999, -999)
        self.assertEqual(result, base)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0], base[0][0])
        self.assertEqual(stamp_matrix([[], []], [[]], 1, 0), [[], []])
        self.assertEqual(stamp_matrix([], [], 0, 0), [])

    def test_rejects_bad_types_and_shapes(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            stamp_matrix(([],), [], 0, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            stamp_matrix([()], [], 0, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            stamp_matrix([], [], True, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            stamp_matrix([], [], 0, 1.0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            stamp_matrix([[1], [2, 3]], [], 0, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            stamp_matrix([[1]], [[2], [3, 4]], 0, 0)

    def test_rejects_out_of_bounds_placement(self):
        base = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
        for top, left in [(-1, 0), (0, -1), (2, 0), (0, 2), (1, 1)]:
            with self.subTest(top=top, left=left):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    stamp_matrix(base, [[9, 8], [7, 6]], top, left)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
